utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left on the list, and where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — we’re mostly short on tape, screws, and a few basic tools. If you can bring any of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can do that — I’ll bring tape, screws, and whatever tools I can find, then check in when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive setup yet, but I’m still watching for the exact spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m still waiting on the exact setup details too, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear where and when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep watching for the exact spot and time too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm — you’ll check what still needs help after your errands, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes — I’ll check what still needs help after my errands and keep everyone posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — that’s all I needed to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate you checking. I’m still hearing bits and pieces, so just let me know what’s left once you’ve asked around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know what’s still needed after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll wait to hear what you find out and pass it along from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s right — tape, screws, and basic tools. I’ll check the garage and bring over whatever I can find.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the exact Saturday time and shed access, so I can plan around it. Once that’s clear, I’ll be there ready to help with unloading.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Pia — just let me know the Saturday time and shed access once it’s set, and I’ll be there too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll keep pickup flexible and wait for the final time. Just send it over when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye — I really appreciate that. I’ll send the final time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just keep me posted, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Saturday morning at the community shed is still the drop-off spot, and I can bring a few extra tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Gus — Saturday morning at the community shed works for me. I’ll bring the drill, tape measure, and screwdrivers, and I’ll help sort the donated tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Sam — that’ll be a big help. I’ll see you Saturday morning at the community shed, and we can sort the donations together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center. I’m matching folks to jobs now, so if you can help check who still needs what, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who still needs what and spread the word about the Sunday move.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — that’s a huge help. If you hear back from anyone, send me their name and what they can take on.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — can you tell me what still needs coverage? I’ll jump in where it’s open.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the sign-ins and sorting, and let you know what’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Leo — I’ll be here and ready to fill any open spots once you’ve checked sign-ins and sorting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — what still needs to be picked up for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A few supplies are still missing — I can check the list and send you the exact items. Want me to do that?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes please — send me the exact items and I’ll grab what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community hall, and we’re fixing up bikes, lamps, and small furniture. If you can, just bring your toolbox and a few hours to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Mina. I’ll bring my toolbox and be there Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Eli — thanks for pitching in. See you Saturday at 10 at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes—can you remind me the time, place, and what I should bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I’m sorry — I don’t have the details in front of me. I’ll check and send them along as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll wait for the details before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now—I'll start with the porch light and then take a look at the tape and screws. Where do you want me to check in after that?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Did anything change, or should I just confirm with you here?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Just confirm with me here — I’ll check the porch light first and then the tape and screws.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the repair-drive list right now, and I can point out what still needs doing too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — send the list, and I’ll check what still needs help after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I’ll send it over right away, and we can compare notes after your errands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I think it’s still the same on my end—I haven’t seen any changes yet. Sorry, I’m a bit behind, but I can help spread the word if you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Noah — could you share the repair drive details with a few neighbors if you can? It’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll share it with a few neighbors. Thanks for the reminder, and sorry I’m a little slow to catch up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — Saturday morning at the community shed works for me. Just let me know if the drop-off process changes so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Looks good — I’ll keep the drop-off the same and let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’ll plan on the shed Saturday morning, then. If anything shifts, please give me a quick heads-up so I can adjust.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — tape, screws, and basic tools. I’ll check the garage and bring over whatever I can find.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — bring them by 10 at the community hall if you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll do my best to be there by 10 with whatever I can find.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — Saturday morning at the community shed is the spot, and folks should drop repairs off there first. I can bring a few extra tools if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — that’ll help a lot. Let’s keep it at the community center on Sunday, and I’ll make sure folks know to bring repairs there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll let folks know it’s at the community center on Sunday, and I can bring a few extra tools too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — could you send me the Saturday time and shed access details? I’ll take a look and see what else still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still waiting on the final Saturday time and shed access details, but I’ll send them over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Sam — thanks. Just let me know as soon as you have them, and I’ll keep organizing from there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can reach out to whoever hasn’t heard yet—who should I make sure to tell?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Please make sure Sam and Leo hear—we still need help with tool sorting and checking sign-ins. If anyone else can pitch in, I can place them where we’re short.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make sure Sam and Leo know, and I’ll ask around for anyone else who can help with sorting and sign-ins.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll start with the porch light and check for tape and screws too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — that helps. Just remind me of the time and place for the repair drive, and I’ll bring my toolbox too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the time and place handy — can you resend it? I’ll keep the porch light, tape, and screws on my list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — let’s set the meeting spot and then I’ll stay on the first task.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I’m still piecing it together, but I’ll pass along the meeting spot and see what else needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell — just let me know the meeting spot, and I’ll take the first task from there.
